The following events took place in '''335 BBY'''.

==Events==
*The [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] government introduces [[Granite slug/Legends|granite slugs]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of land [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusks]], to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] undercity to aid in efforts to clean up refuse that had accumulated over centuries.<ref name="JAS120" />
